content.title: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup
content.summary: Wells Fargo  has recruited an advisory duo in Texas managing $1.2 billion in client assets.  Paul Cooke and Jake Trousdale have joined Wells Fargo’s Private Client Group in Dallas.  The move comes amid a reorganization within  Citigroup  that will see a new CFO take over in March and the firm’s retail banking operations be consolidated and organized within the wealth business, headed by Andy Sieg.
